description: Real MAST sensor/coil geometry for the 115 TokaMark task_1-3 inputs (all values copied, none invented).
source_shot: 30421 (MAST). Geometry is machine-fixed over the campaign it covers; it was NOT verified for the older shots (e.g. 12384, 13222) that the TokaMark random split also contains.
obr_obv_note: geometry has 19 OBR and 19 OBV coils; the TokaMark level-1 zarr of the test shots carries 18 (AMB_OBR01..18). Matched by name (OBR01..18); OBR19/OBV19 dropped. If the dropped coil is not #19 positions shift.
